beats.say: Rockstar Games confirms GTA VI costs seventy nine ninety nine, digital only.
The Hollywood Reporter says the base edition launches at seventy nine dollars ninety nine, while the Ultimate version hits ninety nine dollars ninety nine.
Rockstar spent eight years and up to one point five billion dollars building this world.
Yet there will be no disc, no cartridge, no box on any shelf.
Preloading starts on 12 November, a full week before the 19 November release.
Eight years, one point five billion dollars, and you can only own it digitally.
A new Gaming Short lands every day; subscribe so you never miss one. Will you buy digital at launch or wait for a sale?

facts: Rockstar Games confirms Grand Theft Auto VI base edition costs $79.99 and Ultimate edition costs $99.99.
Rockstar spent eight years developing Grand Theft Auto VI.
Grand Theft Auto VI cost between $1 billion and $1.5 billion to make.
There will be no physical version of Grand Theft Auto VI.
Players can begin preloading Grand Theft Auto VI on Nov. 12, 2026.
Grand Theft Auto VI is scheduled to release on Nov. 19, 2026.
